uth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal\n9:The `mcpjam` CLI is two invocations. Local MCP testing stays at the top l
evel: inspect, debug, and test MCP servers from the command line or CI (connectivity, OAuth, MCP Apps, tools/resources/prompts, pr
otocol conformance). Most local commands are one-shot; `mcpjam mcp` and `subscriptions listen` keep a process open. Account-bound
commands live under `mcpjam cloud` and talk to your MCPJam account. There are no compatibility aliases for the old Cloud paths — s
ee [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md).\n19:To convert existing promptfoo, pytest, Jest, or CSV tests
, use the [MCP eval import skill](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/tree/main/skills/mcpjam-eval-import).\n22:npx skills add mcp
jam/inspector --skill mcpjam-eval-import\n25:To drive MCPJam's hosted eval tools — launch a run, poll it to a verdict, and triage
a failure down to the step — use the [run MCPJam evals skill](https://github.com/MCPJam/inspector/tree/main/skills/run-mcpjam-eval
s). This one is about running suites that already exist, not writing them.\n28:npx skills add mcpjam/inspector --skill run-mcpjam-
evals\n56:| [`test`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals) | Run an eval suite file locally (BYOK or MCPJam-hosted inference);
never uploads | `test <file>` |\n64:| [`apps`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/apps-conformance) | Validate MCP Apps metadata and reso
urce wiring | `conformance`, `conformance-suite` |\n65:| [`oauth`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/oauth-conformance) | Test OAuth flo
ws and conformance against an MCP server | `conformance`, `conformance-suite`, `login`, `metadata`, `proxy` |\n66:| [`protocol`](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference) | MCP protocol conformance checks | `conformance`, `conformance-suite` |\n76:Account-bound c
ommands. Declare `--api-key` / `--api-url` on `mcpjam cloud` (before or after descendants). `mcpjam oauth login` is MCP-server OAu
th; `mcpjam cloud login` is your MCPJam account.\n80:| [`cloud`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-workspace) | Account,
project link, and workspace | `login`, `logout`, `whoami`, `link`, `status`, `organizations`, `projects`, `sessions` |\n81:| [`cl
oud eval`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-eval-commands) | Author and run eval suites in your hosted MCPJam projects
| `create`, `list`, `run`, `status` |\n82:| [`cloud tunnel`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-tunnel) | Expose a local
MCP server through a public MCPJam tunnel URL, registered as a server in your project | `tunnel --server <name> <url>`, `tunnel --
server <name> -- <command>` |\n83:| [`cloud clients`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-clients-commands) | Manage clien
ts in your hosted MCPJam projects (`cloud hosts` is a deprecated alias) | `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `servers`, `duplicate
`, `delete`, `templates` |\n84:| [`cloud environments`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-environments-commands) | Manag
e project environments — the host + servers + pinned skills/plugins bundles eval suites and goals run against | `list`, `get`, `re
solve`, `create`, `update`, `archive`, `restore` |\n85:| [`cloud images`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-images-comma
nds) | Manage custom Computer sandbox images (blueprints) | `list`, `get`, `create`, `validate`, `edit`, `build`, `logs`, `use`, `
reset`, `promote`, `delete` |\n86:| [`cloud skills`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-skills-commands) | List and read
Cloud Skills in your hosted MCPJam projects — discover the skill IDs that `--compose-skill` and `--skill` require (read-only; auth
oring is in the app) | `list`, `get` |\n87:| [`cloud projects servers`](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference#cloud-projects-serve
rs-commands) | Connect MCP servers to a project and manage pending connection requests | `connect`, `connect-status`, `connect-can
cel` |\n89:Also under `mcpjam cloud`: `goals` (`journeys` is a deprecated alias), `personas`, `swarms`, and `studies` (which publi
shes an environment for outside testers and reads what they did; `scenarios` and `user-testing` are deprecated aliases for it). Fu
ll flag tables are in the [command reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md).\n93:`--api-key` and `--api-url` are decla
red on `mcpjam cloud` and work before or after descendants (`mcpjam cloud --api-key sk_… eval list` and `mcpjam cloud eval list --
api-key sk_…` are the same). Local commands, including hosted `readiness`, reject those flags at the program root. Hosted `readine
ss` still takes leaf `--api-key`.\n98:2. `MCPJAM_API_KEY` — same `sk_` rule. A legacy value in this env var is ignored (with a war
ning) so SDK eval reporting can still use it.\n99:3. Stored OAuth from `mcpjam cloud login`\n100:4. Missing — Cloud commands fail
with login guidance before they hit the network (`mcpjam cloud status` reports `missing` instead)\n109:Every command that can cont
act MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides its server when it starts, before it contacts anything. An expl
icit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is not an `http(s)` URL, or that carries credentials, a query or a fr
agment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables naming different servers. The error masks credentials, a query a
nd a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A saved login is only sent to its own server: when it is the credent
ial and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` before any request. `mcpjam cloud status` uses the same checks but s
tays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets `ok: false`, includes `credential.valid` / `deployment.valid` plu
s an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are informational (`credential.valid: null`) and successful.\n111:Successf
ul Cloud commands print an audience line to stderr (`Using MCPJam Cloud as … · project: … · <apiUrl>`). `--quiet` suppresses it. M
achine-readable JSON stays on stdout. `cloud status` redacts API keys.\n123:Empty `--project` or `MCPJAM_PROJECT` is a usage error
. `MCPJAM_PROJECT_ID` does **not** select a Cloud CLI project (it is SDK eval reporting only).\n126:mcpjam cloud login\n127:mcpjam
cloud link # writes .mcpjam/project.json (no secrets)\n128:mcpjam cloud status # zero-network: cr

edential, deployment, selector
129:mcpjam cloud eval list # uses the link
130:mcpjam cloud link --remove

m cloud eval` run-inspection commands (`status`, `cancel`, `judge`, `iterations`, `gate`, `compare`, `trace`, `steps`, `screenshot
`, `video`) follow the same rule — `--project` is optional. `mcpjam cloud sessions list` does too; `--all-projects` restores a cro
ss-project listing and cannot be combined with `--project`. Hosted `readiness` never reads the project link.\n141:| `server`, `too
ls`, `resources`, `prompts` | An **AI client** (`claude`, `chatgpt`, `cursor`, …). The CLI sends that host's `clientInfo`, capabil
ities, and protocol version in `initialize`. |\n142:| `test --host` | One host **template** to emulate for a local suite run: its
handshake, tool visibility and model settings. Never the real client. |\n144:| `cloud eval --host`, `cloud goals`, `cloud studies`
| A **saved project Host** (`<id-or-name>`), the client config an eval or goal run is stamped with. |\n145:| `cloud environments
--host-id` | The project Host id the environment runs as. Distinct from eval's `--host`. |\n151:These flags apply to every command
. Cloud credentials `--api-key` / `--api-url` are declared on `mcpjam cloud`, not the program root.\n168:* **Conformance in CI** —
`protocol conformance`, `protocol conformance-suite`, `oauth conformance`, `oauth conformance-suite`, `apps conformance`, and `ap
